# Display Format Checklist: Status Badge Readable Time

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the requirements for the status badge detail text (time formatting, "since" rule, edge cases, test determinism). Standard depth, for the PR reviewer.
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the detail text defined when no source-status snapshot has been received yet (no envelope at all), as distinct from the `no_data` envelope? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements stated for a `live` status that still carries a non-empty `sources_down` list? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the detail text defined for the stale-connection state shown next to the badge? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the date shown (or deliberately omitted) when the last event or "since" time falls on a different local day than today? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "browser's local time" specified precisely enough (zone source, DST behavior) to give one result per input? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the exact literal text (accents, capitalization, spacing, no trailing punctuation) fixed for all three detail strings? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001–003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the generic fallback wording for `estimated` without a usable "since" given as a requirement rather than only in the assumptions and data model? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "usable" defined for a "since" or last-event value (what counts as unparsable)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the fallback wording for `live` with an unparsable last-event time stated in the spec, not only in the data model? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the Medellín (UTC-5) assumption and the "browser local time" requirement agree for dispatchers whose browser is set to another zone? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK011 Does FR-005 ("header clock unchanged") stay consistent with the new badge format when both are visible together (seconds shown in one, minutes only in another)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the plan's file placement and the task wording consistent about the existing `tests/setup.ts` (plan/tasks say "new" for a file that may already exist)? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can "no raw ISO timestamp visible" be objectively measured for all states, including fallback texts? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "identical regardless of time zone or locale during automated checks" tied to a defined pinned zone and a stated pass condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the pass condition for SC-003 stated beyond "all pass" (coverage scope, which files count)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for "since" values equal to or later than the last-event time? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK017 Are daylight-saving or zone-offset changes between the event and the render addressed or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the transition behavior from `estimated` back to `live` specified for the detail text? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK019 Are seconds-rounding or truncation rules for "since" (shown as HH:MM) stated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Are accessibility requirements (screen-reader reading of the time, `lang`) defined for the detail text? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK021 Is a requirement stated for how text length is handled in the header when the detail wraps or truncates? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK022 Is the assumption that the existing status already provides per-source "since" validated against the generated contract? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the requirement that tests set the time zone in config (not via container flags) recorded as a requirement, not only in the plan and research? [Traceability, Spec §SC-002]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
